head: HEAD

reviews.name: phase22-spec-review
reviews.note: Caught the traffic lights not placed again after leaving full screen, the title row snapping while the sidebar slid, and a lineup test that passed without a resize.

reviews.name: phase22-ponytail-review
reviews.note: Small trims: a default-true flag, one row-inset constant for three paddings, gap for 8.

reviews.name: phase22-visual-review
reviews.note: Found by measuring what nothing else would: the light card shadow's cut-out darkening every Glass light card (a real rendering bug), the 34 pt pill, Classic dark strokes, the terminal and sidebar insets.

reviews.name: phase22-spec-review-2
reviews.note: Docs and table drift after fixes (divider derivation, terminal inset, capsule-vs-cards deviation).

reviews.name: phase22-ponytail-review-2
reviews.note: Nits only; confirmed the new code was lean.

reviews.name: phase22-visual-review-2
reviews.note: The capsule was 4 pt narrower than Rex's slot (inset on all sides), a 2.5 pt sidebar gap, the restore circle twice Rex's strength.

reviews.name: phase22-spec-review-3
reviews.note: Caught the 11 pt glyph rule leaking into the find bar and a per-frame re-render from tracking every card's global frame.

notes: The user added eight requests mid-phase (tabs over cards, minimap, tab bar picture, header buttons, restore, Agents icon, machine chevron, drag image), each a small loop. GUI lock waits cost ~35 min (phase 20's final run overlapped one of mine); a CI push run was cancelled by another phase's push twice. Glass colors needed comparing by steps, not values, since the desktop behind differs.
